title: Mature Maize Garden
description: One static small maize-garden scene with eight complete unchanged mature maize plants in two regular four-plant rows. Each original plant retains its broad folded leaves, terminal tassel and thick lateral husked ear at unit scale. A clear central aisle connects an east-side passage, front entry apron and rear row access; a separate empty parked wheelbarrow has a connected front standing space. Two complete rear timber fence panels retain both original terminal posts and a real separation gap. Eleven full rigid instances of three verified assets stand on one closed scene-only earth slab. Every original oriented triangle, hierarchy and full solid PBR is preserved. One scene and zero new independent models; repeating the same mature plant does not create new growth stages. No seedlings, trays, water, irrigation system, harvested crop, additional tools or new plant geometry. Static visual composition only; no planting recommendation, botany, growth, maturity measurement, yield, productivity, irrigation operation, tool motion, continuous navigation, accessibility/code compliance, structure, load, stability, manufacture or safety certification.
